name: Crop Plus
description: Crop pictures much smaller than Discord allows: after each crop a sheet offers to crop the result again, so the passes add up. Also sets the cropper's starting shape, grid, rotation and can shrink the result. With a self-check.
author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: Found with the decompiled Discord app by Wumpus-Central (discord-mobile-datamining)
